node.title: Re: Optionally / safely disabling a warning category for a complete package
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Corion],

How about using [doc://if]:

no if $] >= 5.020, warnings => 'experimental::signatures';

Inspired by [doc://perl5180delta#New-mechanism-for-experimental-features|perl5180delta].

Update: Changed 5.022 to 5.020 since that's when signatures were added.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
